name: S1WorkerLifecycle

test_list.description: Initialization generates a per-process credential, transfers its bootstrap secret through WorkerBootstrapPlatform, connects through the public local client, verifies readiness, then publishes the exact process tree and client.
Any bootstrap, connect, handshake, or readiness failure leaves no published connection and returns a sanitized supervisor error.
Health checks only the exact retained process tree and do not probe a different generation.
Retiring a stale tree leaves the newer generation's ready connection intact.
Retiring the exact retained tree drops the associated client and tree without retaining credentials.
Debug and public TaskError messages contain only fixed sanitized text and never include credential or private bootstrap error contents.

inputs.name: platform
inputs.description: Platform capable of securely bootstrapping a retained owned worker process.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.description: Configured private local endpoint owned by the worker process composition root.

inputs.name: client_config
inputs.description: Validated S1 client connection, handshake, readiness, and request bounds.

inputs.name: bootstrap_timeout
inputs.description: Maximum time for one credential transfer to the retained child stdin.

output_description: A supervisor lifecycle and authenticated health probe that publishes a client only after exact-tree secret bootstrap, local connection, protocol handshake, and readiness succeed. Retire only clears the matching process tree.
